title: Rainy Room with Painting
description: A dimly lit, dilapidated blue room with a leaking skylight pouring rain onto a wooden table holding a vintage radio, thermos, and scattered papers. A large ornate painting hangs on the wall, depicting an empty stage with red curtains, a stool, microphone, and hazy red lighting.
